title: Frontend: Array to Zigzag String Converter
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Array to Zigzag String Converter. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. Parse words from the Text input by whitespace. Preserve even-indexed words and reverse Unicode code points of odd-indexed words, then join with one space. This exercise defines zigzag as alternating word reversal. Render controlled labelled inputs with these exact names: Text. A Calculate submit button computes the result. Render JSON.stringify(result) in [data-testid="result"]. Validation failure clears result and shows the documented message in [data-testid="error"].
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
First define what zigzag means: here even-indexed words remain unchanged and odd-indexed words reverse by Unicode code points; join with one space.
alternativeApproaches: Extend reversal to user-perceived graphemes and state the required segmentation support.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Empty list; one word; odd/even list lengths.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
